lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E] {f : E → ℝ}
  {α β h : ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ 1 f →
    StrongConvexOn Set.univ α f →
      0 ≤ h →
        β * h ≤ 1 →
          α * h ≤ 1 →
            (∀ (x y : E), f y ≤ f x + inner ℝ (gradient f x) (y - x) + β / 2 * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2) →
              ∀ (x₀ z : E) (N : ℕ),
                (2 * h * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (1 - α * h) ^ k) * (f ((fun x => x - h • gradient f x)^[N] x₀) - f z) ≤
                  (1 - α * h) ^ N * ‖x₀ - z‖ ^ 2
approved_definition_context: ContDiff ℝ 1 f means global continuous Frechet differentiability.
StrongConvexOn univ a f means the chord inequality f((1-t)x+t y) <= (1-t)f(x)+t f(y)-(a/2)t(1-t)||y-x||² for all x,y and 0<=t<=1; a is a real number and this notation alone does not impose a>=0.
gradient f x is the Riesz vector of the Frechet derivative.
Function.iterate T N, written T^[N], is N-fold composition; T^[0] is the identity.
Finset.range N contains 0,...,N-1; a sum over range0 is zero and q^0 is1 including q=0.
